meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会代为清理死代码:先扫全项目找出疑似无用的代码,再用 LSP 逐个确认它们确实没被引用;之后按文件分批派多个并行子代理删除,并在每批成功后单独提交;最后运行类型检查、测试和构建验证,汇总报告。入口文件、测试文件和配置文件不会被删除。
howto.when: 当你说出「remove dead code」「cleanup」「remove unused」等关键词,或直接要求清理项目的无用代码时触发。默认扫描整个项目;如果指定具体文件、目录或符号,只清理那个范围。

say.text: 请清理这个项目里的死代码。
say.note: Claude 会先扫描全项目、逐个验证,再并行删除和提交。

say.text: 只清理 src/hooks 目录下的死代码。
say.note: 扫描范围会收窄到该目录。

say.text: 把 src/utils.ts 里未被引用的导出删掉。

howto.what_en: Claude removes dead code: scans the project, LSP-verifies each candidate, batches by file, fires parallel agents to delete, and commits each batch atomically; then runs typecheck, tests, build, and reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 'remove dead code', 'cleanup' or 'remove unused', or by asking to clean unused project code. Whole project by default; naming a file/directory/symbol narrows it.

say_en.text: Please remove dead code from this project.
say_en.note: Claude scans, verifies, then removes and commits.

say_en.text: Remove unused code only in src/hooks.
say_en.note: Scope is narrowed to that directory.

say_en.text: Find and remove unreferenced exports in src/utils.ts.
